_oauthIntro.text: This adapter uses Ford's official FordConnect Query API. Create an app at https://developer.ford.com/developer-eu (use the same email as your FordPass account), set the Redirect URI, and copy the Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below.

redirectUri.label: Redirect URI
redirectUri.help: Must match exactly the Redirect URI registered in the Ford developer portal.

_loginInstructions.text:
Login:
1. Save the Client ID, Client Secret and Redirect URI, then start the adapter.
2. The adapter prints a login URL in the log. Open it in your browser.
3. Log in with your FordPass account and authorize the app.
4. You are redirected to your Redirect URI with a '?code=...' parameter.
5. Copy the complete redirect URL from the browser address bar.
6. Paste it into the 'Code URL' field below, save and restart the adapter.

codeUrl.label: Code URL (paste from browser after login)
codeUrl.help: Paste the complete redirect URL containing 'code=' here and save. The adapter exchanges it for tokens on the next restart.
